data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic verb ‘istabshara’ which means 'to have good news'. In Islamic context, it is often used to describe a person who receives good news, especially after a long wait or struggle. The name is also associated with the concept of sabr (patience) and tawakkul (trust in Allah), as one must endure hardships and remain steadfast in their faith before receiving good news.
